utility.notes: Nevada City is confirmed to be within PG&E's electric distribution territory.

value.name: Pioneer Community Energy
value.notes: Pioneer Community Energy's own official service-area page confirms Nevada City as an active member community, service starting January 2024. PG&E continues to deliver the power and provide billing/customer service.

permit_authority.value: Nevada County Building Department (contracted by the City of Nevada City)
permit_authority.notes: Nevada City contracts with Nevada County for building department services. Applicants first apply with the City; once approved, city-approved plans are submitted to the Nevada County Building Department.

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Nevada City/Nevada County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

value.program_or_pathway: Administrative, nondiscretionary expedited review process for small residential rooftop solar systems, conforming to the California Solar Permitting Guidebook
other_conditions: Permit fees, if adopted by city council resolution, must comply with Government Code Sections 65850.55 and 66015
